creative_simplicity: Do not clutter the ad with unnecessary information.

Default element budget: 1 headline, 0–3 supporting, 1 CTA, 1 logo.

Avoid large bottom bands, unnecessary badges, and repeating price messages.
Premium ≠ more elements. No forced left/bottom panels.

art_direction.cta_prominence: CTA zone (OS typesets — do NOT draw text): reserve high-contrast actionable area for 'Detayları Keşfet' — button/pill air only, no rasterized CTA.
art_direction.badge_callout_opportunity: Optional feature badges near callout cluster — only if they strengthen lifestyle story.
art_direction.contrast_strategy: Warm interior palette with navy/ivory type — high contrast for headline and CTA, not price panels
art_direction.negative_space_usage: Conscious breath around headline, feature callouts, and CTA — premium composition, not meaningless empty canvas or random decorative gaps.
art_direction.image_text_balance: Locked living-room interior carries atmosphere; type zones get composed air — roughly 60% visual / 40% message space, flexible not fixed panels.
art_direction.brand_presence: The Temple project logo zone — upper area, visible air only; OS composites real SVG, never AI-generated
art_direction.decoration_rule: Decoration only if it serves campaign: no random building sketch, map pin, long gold line, or watermark unless it strengthens sales or brand story.

creative_brief_summary.prompt_excerpt:
FINISHED PROFESSIONAL INSTAGRAM AD — Instagram 4:5 — LANGUAGE: tr.
Deliver a publishable, flattened social advertisement — typography, price hierarchy, CTA, and brand lockups integrated in the composition (not a blank background for later overlay).

LANGUAGE LOCK:
- Campaign language is tr. All user-visible slogans, headlines, CTAs, and supporting lines MUST be tr.
- Do not invent or render English slogans/headlines/CTAs when language is tr.

CAMPAIGN INTENT:
- launch
- Primary focus: Tarihi ve modern yaşamın buluştuğu şık bir iç mekan.
- Emotional angle: Tarihi ve modern yaşamın harmanlandığı bir deneyim.

CREATIVE DIRECTOR PRODUCTION BRIEF:
- Objective: The Temple'ın premium yaşam tarzını ve iç mekanlarını tanıtmak.
- Big Idea: Zamansız Yaşam
- Hero: Zamansız Yaşam
- Sales Hook: Tarihi ve modern yaşamın buluştuğu nokta.
- Offer: 
- Supporting (max 2): Editoryal lüks ve minimal tasarım. · Sade ve şık iç mekanlar.
- CTA: Detayları Keşfet

DESIGN DIRECTION (creative freedom — no fixed panels):
- Visual mood: Editoryal lüks ve minimalizm vurgulanmalı.
- Hierarchy: One dominant read in the first 2 seconds; secondary lines quieter; CTA actionable; logo present once.
- Typography character: Minimal ve zarif yazı tipleri kullanılmalı.
- Composition: Fotoğrafın nefes almasına izin ver, sade ve şık bir düzen.
- Image treatment: Preserve real project interior architecture/photography — enhance atmosphere, do not redesign. Subtle grade toward premium RE editorial.
- Contrast: High readability for primary message and CTA against the locked photograph
- Brand presence: One verified project logo lockup — never invent or duplicate
- CTA importance: Single clear CTA; visible and actionable, not tiny footer text
- Information density: medium
- Premium level: elevated
- Freedom: Language=tr. LEVEL 1 CONTROLLED — approved interiors only. Placement freedom without forced panels; do not invent room geometry.

CREATIVE SIMPLICITY (quality principle — not a fixed layout):
  - ONE AD = ON
